infobox.usage: Unlocks a door in the Repair Warehouses of the Repair Point Buildings on Reserve.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-ST key (RB-ST) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Federal State Reserve Agency base military equipment care and attention service and repair centre.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- Used in the Quest Surplus Goods
- Used in the Quest Revision - Reserve
- Used in the Quest Snatch

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text: - In different locations in the dining room on the third floor of the repair building marked with black knight.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: In the Repair Warehouses of the Repair Point Buildings on Reserve.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- One Weapon box (6x6)
- One Weapon box (6x2)
- One Weapon box (6x4)
- Two Grenade boxes
- Loose loot (Ammunition, Weapon mods and Electronics)
- Two 6-STEN-140-M military battery spawns
- Three OFZ 30x165mm shell spawns
- Two Phased array element spawns
- One Military gyrotachometer spawn
- One Military cable spawn
- One TP-200 TNT brick spawn
